serendipity_bridge.synthesis_notes: Explaining a complex recursive idea in simple steps can expose assumptions; this is an analogy, not a mathematical reduction.

core_essence.foundation: A debugging technique in which a programmer explains code or a problem step by step, aloud or in writing, to help reveal mistakes or misunderstandings.
core_essence.philosophical_anchor: Externalizing reasoning can make implicit assumptions easier to inspect.
core_essence.functional_role: A self-review technique for identifying candidate gaps in code or system proposals.

narrative_externalization.definition: Describing the intended logic step by step.
narrative_externalization.project_application: Use a written walkthrough to surface missing conditions and unstated constraints.

neutral_reflection.definition: The listener or writing process does not need to supply an answer for the explanation to be useful.
neutral_reflection.project_application: Create a low-pressure self-review step; solutions are not guaranteed or necessarily immediate.

cross_reference_links.synergy: Stepwise explanation can make recursive complexity more inspectable.

adventure_quests.title: The Out-Loud Logic Audit
adventure_quests.objective: Explain a stuck module or design step by step and compare intended behavior with observed behavior.
adventure_quests.outcome: Record candidate gaps to test; resolution is not guaranteed.
